strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
No way! Not pirates!
I ran away from Dr. Tarsan's once already
because I didn't want to be sold off here!
Shut up! I've remembered too...
where I truly belong...!
What's this all about, Pai!
No welcome, huh...
Hey, wait!
I have returned... Father...
F-Father!?
Barias... I hear you... ran away from Tarsan...
That's a misunderstanding... Tarsan manipulated my memories,
and that's why...!
You betrayed us once... The Bunker does not trust traitors...
Father! Please, show me your face! And look at me...!
I am still your loyal daughter... Barias!
No way... Pai...!?
I entrusted you to Tarsan to amplify your psychic powers
and make you an invincible weapon... I trust only those who risk their lives!
...Father...!
You're kidding, Pai! That... that can't be...!
Prove that you have become the ultimate weapon...
that you have become a killing machine. ...Then
I shall acknowledge you as my daughter, Barias...
H-How... do I do that!?
Kill the man you brought with you! That shall prove your loyalty to me!
Huh...!? Pai!?
...I am a weapon... That's why he sent me to Tarsan...
By becoming a weapon... I'll make Father happy...!
Pai... stop it, Pai! Are you really... really...!?
In the battles so far... I've struck down many people...
Become a perfect killing machine... a murderer...!
Yes... my daughter. That is exactly the quality I demand of you.
Pai?
What... what did I even come back here for...!?
All I wanted... was my memories... to find out who I really am...
That's all it was...
Kill that man, and show your loyalty to the Bunker...!
What's wrong... Barias?
...I'm Pai Thunder! I'm not Barias...!
...Traitor!
Hang in there! Pai! Roll!
Mia!
Mia! Lamba! ...I...
...You don't have to say anything, Pai.
...The four of us are linked by telepathy, after all...
Even without words, we can more or less tell.
...Sorry...
So you've come... Heh heh. The strongest combat robot
Tarsan ever built...!
That's... Grand Captain Garimos...! Everyone, let's combine...!
Got it!
Okay!
...Let's do it...!
...Hearts as one... Cross Fiiight! Dan-gai-ohhh!
Dangaioh, ready for battle!
So that is your answer, Barias...!
Father... No, Grand Captain Garimos...! I've changed.
Meeting the people of Earth...! There was a father praying for his child,
a man fighting to right his father's wrongs... My fight starts here!
Heh... Hahahahahahaha! Well said, little girl!
Ties of blood no longer matter! As ruler of the space pirates, the Bunker,
I shall bury you!
The power of Dangaioh...! Don't underestimate it, Bunker pirates...!
I've been wanting to see that power. Heh heh... All according to plan.
...I thought getting here was way too easy...
So they let us through... is that it...
Heh heh heh... Exactly... Come forth!
So you've come, Dangaioh Team... No, Roll Kran.
Today, before Grand Captain Garimos, we'll take your lives.
Show us a lovely death.
Aah! Them again!
Roll... those two...
Yeah... Don't worry, Mia. ...I'm going to overcome my past too!
They're not my old comrades... They're Bunker executives,
Flash and Burst!
Let's go... everyone...!
You'll regret bringing us all together!
No, no...! You're the one who's supposed to die, Roll!
Flaaaash!!
I won't die... I refuse to... aaaaaaah!
Th-This... This can't be happening!
Burst! Get out!
We were going to... earn glory here! Rise in the Bunker...!
Ngh, did we get him?
Looks like it... If that didn't do it...
Ugh... uuh... W-Wasn't I... the ultimate warrior Tarsan built...!?
It's true... that machine had tremendous power.
But...
What... was I lacking...
The moment you let the flames of revenge consume you...
the outcome of this battle was decided.
Let's end this now... Gil.
Yaaay! We beat the grand captain!
All right, let's get ready to bail out of here!
Wait... Looks like it's not over yet...
Heh... heh... And yet you went and flew right in... with the treasure...
all by yourselves...
Treasure...!?
You mean the Star of La Mu...?
The Star of La Mu Mom protected... I won't give it up so easily!
What were you planning to do with Mutron's power!
Is it not obvious... I have conquered many planets
in the name of the Bunker... but the universe is vast...
and so I need eternal life, that is all...
Eternal life!? Old man! Quit dreaming!
Eternal life here, too... Is it really that great?
To live a limited life to the fullest... that is what gives life its value...
Those were Father's words.
Master Kirai... Truly fine words.
You hear that, pirate scum!
(So... the Hyper Libido and the Star of La Mu hold similar powers?
Earth and planet Cronos... What could connect them...?)
...Fools... Not even knowing what that treasure means...
Your mother protected it...? Nonsense...
You...!
That's why you lost... you.
Barias... you...
Ngh... We're through! Princess!
This is... the core, isn't it!?
That's...!
Whoa! It's the Elshank!
What!? Where on earth did that come from!
I never said to let anyone but the Dangaioh Team through!
Microworm navigation... Of course!
Are you all right, everyone?
Yoo-hoo, Princess Romina! We're still good!
...So this is the Bunker's home base!
That... is Shema's battleship... Warping straight into my flagship.
...Interesting...!
Damn, that was one hell of a rough ride.
Seriously. Princess Romina, next time we do this,
first-class treatment, please.
First... class? Is that a battle formation?
I still have much to learn...
Princess Romina, we're in combat...! Hey, she's an alien. Think.
Whoa, that's right. Okay, so first class is...
Enough already! Captain, I'm launching!
Come on, it's just the usual banter, Tetsuya.
All right, let's launch!
That's...!
Whoa! It's the Nadesico!
What!? Where on earth did that come from!
I never said to let anyone but the Dangaioh Team through!
Microworm navigation... Of course!
The Nadesico has Boson Jumped.
Ugh, honestly...! We're running low on CC, you know!?
Are you all right, everyone?
Yoo-hoo, Princess Romina! We're still good!
...So this is the Bunker's home base!
That... is an Earth battleship... Warping straight into my flagship.
...Interesting...!
...Well, whatever.
All hands, launch! While supporting Dangaioh,
we'll defeat the Bunker's leader!
When you think about it calmly, this operation seems insane...
But it's strange, being in this unit makes me feel it'll work out somehow.
Looks like Erina's finally getting the hang of Londo Bell and the Nadesico.
And so, we're gonna beat up the space pirate boss!
Thanks, I owe you.
Why'd you come all the way out here, Pai?
Huh... Oh, this place is...
Pai...
...Because this used to be my home...
Whaaat!?
...Used to be?
Pai, we're in battle. ...You needn't say what you'd rather not...
We kinda get it anyway.
Just one message. ..."You're like a daughter to me,
so please come home soon." That's from Dr. Tarsan.
Daughter... The doctor said that...?
Let's get you home soon. ...You can do it, right? Dangaioh Team.
Pirate hunting, eh? Has a nice romantic ring to it.
Already think you've won... Heh heh heh. When I haven't yet played
all my pieces.
Big talk!
...I wouldn't think so. But... we must defeat him
before the surrounding fleet intervenes. ...How long until
we can use Microworm navigation again?
10 more... minutes.
Hey, Quattro, why's that?
This is the heart of the enemy fleet. ...Surrounded by thousands of ships
and tens of thousands of enemies... even the Tobikage wouldn't last.
True...
Enemies all around, huh... Sounds like fun.
10 minutes... Heh, bring it on!
All right, commit all forces and annihilate the enemy!
All riiight! They're space pirates, so I can cut loose with no holding back!
But they look pretty tough...
Come to think of it... do we still have CC?
Rest assured.
I figured it would come to this, so I loaded all of Nergal's stock
onto the Nadesico.
That's Prospector for you, always thinking ahead.
What are you saying! Precious CC would never come our way
unless the Chairman approved it.
Well, we may gather more CC later, but the Nadesico's another story.
After all, every Nergal battleship but the Nadesico has been sunk.
Ugh...
Are you really okay with this... Pai?
...Yeah... The place I belong... isn't here...!
Barias... you will regret this... Heh heh heh.
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Victory conditions not met within 13 turns
Heh heh heh, not bad... I see, I can almost understand
why he's so obsessed... heh.
Show, hey! He seems awfully relaxed!?
He's still... hiding something.
Don't let your guard down!
Heh... You're up, Gil Berg!
I knew it...!
I had a feeling.
Bring it...!
Gil...!
Heh heh heh heh... Never thought we'd end up fighting here.
Gil... Do we really have to kill
each other!?
Enough of this, Mia Alice!
No good... This one's hopeless.
It's pointless talking to someone who can't understand the heart.
...Gil, I used to think things like heart and sentiment
had no place in a fight. But... I was wrong.
You poor man... Gil, what are you trying to gain
by all this...?
Tch... Nonsense! Sentiment has no place in battle!
I'll make you understand that right now!
You're the one who'll understand! Feel this power, Gil Berg!
Tch... A guy who'd sell out his own comrades shouldn't run his mouth.
Flash...
Small fry... Useless fool...
Gil, you...!
That was a nasty opponent...
Yes... Not hatred or anger... People who start wars out of greed...
That is the mark of a true pirate. Greed is the source of all power!
I won't forgive you... Damn you, Bunker!
Gil...
Bye-bye... you human weapon... driven mad by revenge...
...Whatever my parents were... I'm gonna live by the path
I chose myself...
...Pai.
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
We drove them all back!?
Looks like it. I'd love a breather... but we don't have time, right?
Indeed. With their leader fallen, they seem to be in some
disarray... However, a large fleet is heading
our way, it seems.
How's it look, Ruri?
If I counted them exactly, we'd run out of time to escape.
Whoa, that's bad.
Then we'd better hurry. Princess, is your pumpkin carriage
ready to roll?
Pumpkin... Oh, you mean the Elshank.
Shaff?
We can go. Everyone, please return to the ship!
Hurry!
All units, return to the ship, now!
Nadesico, prepare for Boson Jump! Distortion Field to maximum output!
All crew and pilots, please stand by.
All right... Hm? Pai?
...There seems to be a story there.
So that's it... Now I've got nowhere to go back to...
Same here, Pai.
Lamba... That's right.
But we avenged planet Lilith... avenged everyone.
Yes, Princess. ...Surely the people of Lilith are rejoicing
as well...
We still don't know when anyone can live on our planet Fleed again...
But for the sake of everyone who suffered,
we have to keep going.
Right. As long as it lives in your heart... your home can never be lost.
Heh... Smooth as ever, Duke Fleed.
Hey! Get back here already! The enemy's right on top of us!
I dunno what happened, but quit moping over stupid crap!
Wow... He sure knows how to kill the mood.
Shinobu! Can't you read the room at all!?
It's fine, Yuki. ...Heh... I'm okay.
...Don't need Fujiwara of all people telling me!
Tch, say what you want! ...That's more like you.
Heh... Thanks, Fujiwara.
Cheer up, Mia. It's over. Gil... that was the only way he
could've ended.
...Yeah, I know... I know...
Pirates who sail the sea of space... We may fight them again someday.
Huh? But we beat their captain, didn't we, Brother?
A new captain will rise. That is... the history of war, Leina.
